requirement: Use [Parameter] { get; set; } auto-properties; no required/init (BL0007) and no internal parameter mutation.
scope: Component-owned source, including inherited members, partial declarations and rendering/event bindings.
evidence_boundary: Inspect every applicable declaration and component-owned write, including conditional event and callback paths. A permitted path does not cancel a conflicting path. Complete source may establish this source-level requirement; it does not prove browser or runtime behavior.

status_definitions.verified: Direct applicable evidence satisfies every part of the requirement. Cite the supporting source.
status_definitions.gap: Direct evidence conflicts with at least one required part. Cite the conflict even if other parts are satisfied.
status_definitions.owner evidence required: The unresolved fact requires an owner-held record, attestation, approval or inaccessible control. Name the needed evidence.
status_definitions.not tested: The requirement applies, but independently obtainable evidence was blocked, not obtained or insufficient. State the missing evidence.
status_definitions.not applicable: Direct scope evidence establishes that the requirement has no applicable surface. Unknown applicability is not enough.
